research_role: article-level structured event extraction; no return forecast and no trading action
selection_basis: Operational correction after the v3.4 full extraction reached batch 14 and exposed both corrupted quote characters in one frozen headline and absent model evidence in another. V3.5 keeps strict alignment first; only on alignment failure it replaces evidence_span with the complete frozen headline and records evidence_fallback=true. All frozen headlines are at most 198 characters, below the 240-character evidence limit. Event classifications are never repaired. Model, sample, prompt, response schema, batch size, seed, and prior agreement thresholds are unchanged; no market outcome or trading result was consulted.

prior_operational_failure.reason: one frozen headline contained corrupted quote characters and another model item supplied evidence absent from its headline, causing exact-substring validation to reject the four-item batch

stage1_gate.decision: all requirements must pass before full-corpus extraction

stage2_only_if_stage1_passes.scope: one full extraction over 39393 articles; no outcome join, predictive test, threshold selection, backtest, or Tech overlay

prohibited: changing prompt, schema, model digest, sample, batch size, or gate thresholds after Stage 1 begins
joining market outcomes before the full extraction artifact is complete and frozen
creating action, position size, or Tech overlay fields in the extractor
running more than one LLM worker
continuing compute at NVIDIA GPU temperature 75 C or above
